fundamentals.summary: INARI has a strong balance sheet and positive supplied cash flow, but the investment case currently depends on a large earnings recovery: the supplied trailing P/E is 85.0x versus 28.934528x forward. The latest 4QFY2026 filing showed revenue down to RM288.942m from RM306.712m and attributable profit down to RM6.146m from RM49.169m, so the recovery is not yet proven. The fundamental signal is sell at medium confidence until earnings and margins stabilize; low leverage is the main offset.
